import pytest
    from typesystem.fields import Integer, String

    class User(Schema):
        name = String()
        age = Integer(minimum=0)
        role = String(default="user")

    user = User(name="Alice", age=30)
    assert user.name == "Alice"
    assert user.age == 30
    assert user.role == "user"
    assert not user.is_sparse

    sparse_user = User(name="Bob")
    assert sparse_user.name == "Bob"
    assert not hasattr(sparse_user, "age")
    assert sparse_user.role == "user"
    assert sparse_user.is_sparse

    dict_user = User({"name": "Carol", "age": 25, "unknown": "ignored"})
    assert dict_user.name == "Carol"
    assert dict_user.age == 25
    assert not hasattr(dict_user, "role")
    assert not hasattr(dict_user, "unknown")
    assert dict_user.is_sparse

    class Source:
        name = "Dave"
        age = 40

    object_user = User(Source())
    assert object_user.name == "Dave"
    assert object_user.age == 40
    assert not hasattr(object_user, "role")
    assert object_user.is_sparse

    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"Invalid argument 'age' for User\(\)"):
        User(name="Eve", age=-1)

    with pytest.raises(
        TypeError,
        match=r"'unknown' is an invalid keyword argument for User\(\)\.",
    ):
        User(name="Frank", age=20, unknown=True)

    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        User({"name": "Grace"}, age=20)

    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        User({"name": "Heidi"}, {"age": 20})

        name = Field()
        age = Field()

    identical = ExampleSchema({"name": "Alice", "age": 30})
    different = ExampleSchema({"name": "Alice", "age": 31})

    assert value == identical
    assert value != different
    assert value != {"name": "Alice", "age": 30}
    assert value != object()

import pytest

    class UpperCaseField(Field):
        errors = {"invalid": "Must be a string."}

        def validate(
            self, value: typing.Any, *, strict: bool = False
        ) -> typing.Any:
            if not isinstance(value, str):
                raise self.validation_error("invalid")
            return value.upper()

    class ExampleSchema(Schema):
        name = UpperCaseField()
        status = UpperCaseField(default="pending")

    instance = ExampleSchema(name="alice", status="ready")
    assert instance.name == "ALICE"
    assert instance.status == "READY"

    instance_with_default = ExampleSchema(name="bob")
    assert instance_with_default.name == "BOB"
    assert instance_with_default.status == "pending"

    sparse_instance = ExampleSchema()
    assert not hasattr(sparse_instance, "name")
    assert sparse_instance.status == "pending"
    assert sparse_instance.is_sparse

    dictionary_instance = ExampleSchema(
        {"name": 123, "status": "raw", "ignored": "value"}
    )
    assert dictionary_instance.name == 123
    assert dictionary_instance.status == "raw"
    assert not hasattr(dictionary_instance, "ignored")

    class Source:
        name = "unvalidated"

    object_instance = ExampleSchema(Source())
    assert object_instance.name == "unvalidated"
    assert not hasattr(object_instance, "status")
    assert object_instance.is_sparse

    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="Invalid argument 'name'"):
        ExampleSchema(name=123)

    with pytest.raises(
        TypeError,
        match="'unknown' is an invalid keyword argument for ExampleSchema",
    ):
        ExampleSchema(name="alice", unknown=True)

    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        ExampleSchema({}, name="alice")

    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        ExampleSchema({}, {})
